description: Lekan is Vincent Cloarec's graphical application for hydrological and hydraulic studies within the Reos Project. It uses a QGIS-based environment to organise watersheds, rainfall, hydrographs and linked hydraulic elements. Inputs include catchment information, rainfall or gauged flows, routing parameters and configured hydraulic domains; outputs include routed hydrographs, numerical tables and mapped two-dimensional results. Geographic coverage and time resolution are user-configured. Public source is free under GPL-2.0-or-later, with Windows installers and source-build guidance. A limitation is that capabilities differ by external engine: the documented TELEMAC interface supports model creation, while HEC-RAS integration imports existing models. Required solvers and their terms must be checked separately. Lekan can connect runoff and hydraulic calculations for infrastructure flood studies, complementary to Delft3D FM (model-delft3d-fm). Its wiki documents Muskingum routing, boundary connections and engine-specific limitations. No installer, catchment data or solver model was downloaded.
name: Lekan hydrological and hydraulic modelling
